recommendation: Keep this audit as-is for the core combined branch. Future changes to the originalText StructureDefinition should be made in HL7/fhir-extensions; core should only be changed if its extension links, examples, or OID references become inaccurate.
issue_request: FHIR-17310 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core datatypes change request to create a standard extension for preserving original free text that was subsequently encoded as a date, number, boolean, ratio, or similar datatype value.
initial_application: Jira comments cite SVN revisions 14075 and 14113, and git commit b6506393954c788390d3f7a5aff8502df8970a6a added originalText to source/profiles/general-extensions-spreadsheet.xml with the requested original-text semantics.
additional_context: FHIR-15840 supplied the Pharmacy free-text strength use case and resolved to use a datatype extension. Later source ownership changed: dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed extensions from R5 core source, while the FHIR Extension Pack imported and now maintains StructureDefinition-originalText.xml.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. The current maintained originalText StructureDefinition is in /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions/input/definitions/Element/StructureDefinition-originalText.xml, and current core source links to it through [%extensions-location%] plus retains its OID in source/oids.ini.
